data.name: FIND KITTENS 10: Valentine's Day 😻🐾💖
data.detailed_description:
Embark on an amazing journey through exciting hand-drawn paradise landscapes and find cute cats cleverly hidden among monumental buildings, flying Cupids, and living creatures in love. Each cat you find transforms the monochrome scene into a vibrant illustration. Calm, atmospheric music will will provide complete relaxation. Suitable for the whole family)

Game Features:

250 hidden cats

There is a hint

The map is colorable

2.5D effect

Customize brightness

Saving progress

Scaling

Relaxing music
